## d68754fb0d84

**Reproduced teaching defect: unseen control codes in a generated lesson.** Generator SHA-256 `5fb91765ac44f745336ffb07cfe6673bf53a2064bf338eb9dcb786d9c025cc31`; executed rule hash `edea3d411dc3`.

At seed 17, difficulty `easy`, consecutive sample indices 4–7, the first three generated demonstrations use control-code sets `{3,8}`, `{3}`, and `{4}`. The query uses codes `{2,7}`, neither of which appears in a demonstration. All four grids pass the target `self_check` and belong to the documented default generator domain.

A rival that uses the canonical transforms for observed codes but defaults unseen codes 2 and 7 to identity matches all three Racket-labelled demonstrations and differs from the Racket query output at six cells. Thus the lesson does not teach the meanings of the query controls, even though every label is correct. Exact grids, rival outputs, Racket outputs, hashes, and the supported apply command are in `checks/audit/d68754fb0d84/counterexample.json`; raw apply provenance is in `racket.json`.

No patch was applied to this audit target. A targeted repair would ensure that every query control code is demonstrated, or declare and gate a family of unseen-code rivals during production lesson assembly.
